mapper.sql: select p.id, p.policy_code, p.policy_name, p.subject_type, p.subject_value, p.subject_name, p.include_child, p.status, p.remark, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time, case when exists (select 1 from sys_biz_perm_scope s where s.policy_id = p.id and s.scope_type = 'DEPT' and ltrim(rtrim(s.include_child)) = '1') then '1' else '0' end as scope_include_child from sys_biz_perm_policy p
mapper.select: where id = #{id}
mapper.sql: from sys_user u inner join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = u.dept_id where u.status = '0' and u.del_flag = '0' and exists ( select 1 from sys_biz_perm_policy p inner join sys_biz_perm_scope s on s.policy_id = p.id where p.policy_code = #{policyCode} and p.status = '0' and ( (p.subject_type = 'USER' and p.subject_value = #{userCode}) or (p.subject_type = 'POST' and exists ( select 1 from sys_user_post up inner join sys_post po on po.post_id = up.post_id and po.status = '0' inner join sys_user cu on cu.user_id = up.user_id where cu.user_name = #{userCode} and cu.del_flag = '0' and up.post_id = try_cast(p.subject_value as bigint) )) or (p.subject_type = 'DEPT' and exists ( select 1 from sys_user cu inner join sys_dept cd on cd.dept_id = cu.dept_id where cu.user_name = #{userCode} and cu.del_flag = '0' and (cd.dept_id = try_cast(p.subject_value as bigint) or (ltrim(rtrim(p.include_child)) = '1' and charindex(',' + p.subject_value + ',', ',' + cd.ancestors + ',') > 0)) )) ) and ( (s.scope_type = 'USER' and s.scope_value = u.user_name) or (s.scope_type = 'POST' and exists ( select 1 from sys_user_post up2 inner join sys_post po2 on po2.post_id = up2.post_id and po2.status = '0' where up2.user_id = u.user_id and up2.post_id = try_cast(s.scope_value as bigint) )) or (s.scope_type = 'DEPT' and ( u.dept_id = try_cast(s.scope_value as bigint) or (ltrim(rtrim(s.include_child)) = '1' and charindex(',' + s.scope_value + ',', ',' + d.ancestors + ',') > 0) )) ) )

owner_policies as ( select p.id from sys_biz_perm_policy p where p.policy_code = #{policyCode} and p.status = '0' and ( (p.subject_type = 'USER' and p.subject_value = #{userCode}) or (p.subject_type = 'POST' and exists ( select 1 from sys_user cu inner join sys_user_post up on up.user_id = cu.user_id where cu.user_name = #{userCode} and cu.del_flag = '0' and up.post_id = try_cast(p.subject_value as bigint) )) or (p.subject_type = 'DEPT' and exists ( select 1 from sys_user cu inner join sys_dept cd on cd.dept_id = cu.dept_id where cu.user_name = #{userCode} and cu.del_flag = '0' and (cd.dept_id = try_cast(p.subject_value as bigint) or (ltrim(rtrim(p.include_child)) = '1' and charindex(',' + p.subject_value + ',', ',' + cd.ancestors + ',') > 0)) )) ) )
mapper.select:
select distinct u.user_name
order by u.user_name
select count(distinct u.user_name)

select distinct u.user_name as user_code, u.nick_name as nick_name, u.dept_id as dept_id, d.dept_name as dept_name
order by u.user_name

with visible_users as ( select distinct u.user_id, u.user_name, u.dept_id, d.ancestors as dept_ancestors
), , dept_scopes as ( select s.scope_value as dept_id, max(s.include_child) as include_child, min(s.order_num) as order_num from sys_biz_perm_scope s inner join owner_policies op on op.id = s.policy_id where s.scope_type = 'DEPT' group by s.scope_value ), assigned as ( select vu.user_name, coalesce(ds.dept_id, cast(vu.dept_id as nvarchar(64))) as group_dept_id, coalesce(ds.include_child, '0') as include_child, coalesce(ds.order_num, 2147483647) as order_num from visible_users vu outer apply ( select top 1 x.dept_id, x.include_child, x.order_num from dept_scopes x where x.dept_id = cast(vu.dept_id as nvarchar(64)) or (ltrim(rtrim(x.include_child)) = '1' and charindex(',' + x.dept_id + ',', ',' + vu.dept_ancestors + ',') > 0) order by x.order_num, x.dept_id ) ds ) select cast(a.group_dept_id as bigint) as dept_id, d.dept_name as dept_name, a.include_child as include_child, count(distinct a.user_name) as user_count, 0 as returned_count from assigned a inner join sys_dept d on cast(d.dept_id as nvarchar(64)) = a.group_dept_id group by a.group_dept_id, d.dept_name, a.include_child order by min(a.order_num), a.group_dept_id

with visible_users as ( select distinct u.user_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name, u.dept_id, d.ancestors as dept_ancestors
), , dept_scopes as ( select s.scope_value as dept_id, max(s.include_child) as include_child, min(s.order_num) as order_num from sys_biz_perm_scope s inner join owner_policies op on op.id = s.policy_id where s.scope_type = 'DEPT' group by s.scope_value ), assigned as ( select vu.user_id, vu.user_name, vu.nick_name, vu.dept_id as user_dept_id, coalesce(ds.dept_id, cast(vu.dept_id as nvarchar(64))) as group_dept_id, coalesce(ds.include_child, '0') as include_child, coalesce(ds.order_num, 2147483647) as order_num from visible_users vu outer apply ( select top 1 x.dept_id, x.include_child, x.order_num from dept_scopes x where x.dept_id = cast(vu.dept_id as nvarchar(64)) or (ltrim(rtrim(x.include_child)) = '1' and charindex(',' + x.dept_id + ',', ',' + vu.dept_ancestors + ',') > 0) order by x.order_num, x.dept_id ) ds ) select cast(a.group_dept_id as bigint) as group_dept_id, gd.dept_name as group_dept_name, a.include_child as include_child, a.user_name as user_code, a.nick_name as nick_name, a.user_dept_id as dept_id, ud.dept_name as dept_name from assigned a inner join sys_dept gd on cast(gd.dept_id as nvarchar(64)) = a.group_dept_id left join sys_dept ud on ud.dept_id = a.user_dept_id order by a.order_num, a.group_dept_id, a.user_name offset #{offset} rows fetch next #{pageSize} rows only

select 'OWNER:' + p.subject_type + ':' + p.subject_value as node_key, 'OWNER' as node_type, cast(null as nvarchar(200)) as parent_key, coalesce(max(nullif(p.subject_name, '')), max(u.nick_name), max(po.post_name), max(d.dept_name), p.subject_value) + '（' + p.subject_value + '）' as label, p.subject_value as code, cast(1 as bit) as has_children, cast(0 as bit) as leaf, cast(case when max(case when p.status = '0' then 0 else 1 end) = 1 then 1 else 0 end as bit) as disabled from sys_biz_perm_policy p left join sys_user u on p.subject_type = 'USER' and u.user_name = p.subject_value and u.del_flag = '0' left join sys_post po on p.subject_type = 'POST' and cast(po.post_id as nvarchar(64)) = p.subject_value left join sys_dept d on p.subject_type = 'DEPT' and cast(d.dept_id as nvarchar(64)) = p.subject_value
and (p.subject_value like '%' + #{keyword} + '%' or p.subject_name like '%' + #{keyword} + '%' or u.nick_name like '%' + #{keyword} + '%' or p.policy_code like '%' + #{keyword} + '%' or p.policy_name like '%' + #{keyword} + '%')
group by p.subject_type, p.subject_value order by p.subject_type, p.subject_value

select 'SCENE:' + p.subject_type + ':' + p.subject_value + ':' + p.policy_code as node_key, 'SCENE' as node_type, 'OWNER:' + p.subject_type + ':' + p.subject_value as parent_key, max(p.policy_name) + '（' + p.policy_code + '）' as label, p.policy_code as code, cast(1 as bit) as has_children, cast(0 as bit) as leaf, cast(case when max(case when p.status = '0' then 0 else 1 end) = 1 then 1 else 0 end as bit) as disabled from sys_biz_perm_policy p
and (p.policy_code like '%' + #{keyword} + '%' or p.policy_name like '%' + #{keyword} + '%')
group by p.subject_type, p.subject_value, p.policy_code order by p.subject_type, p.subject_value, p.policy_code

select 'DEPT:' + cast(min(s.policy_id) as nvarchar(20)) + ':' + s.scope_value as node_key, 'DEPT' as node_type, 'SCENE:' + p.subject_type + ':' + p.subject_value + ':' + p.policy_code as parent_key, coalesce(max(d.dept_name), max(nullif(s.scope_name, '')), s.scope_value) + case when ltrim(rtrim(max(s.include_child))) = '1' then '（含下级）' else '' end as label, s.scope_value as code, cast(1 as bit) as has_children, cast(0 as bit) as leaf, cast(case when max(case when p.status = '0' then 0 else 1 end) = 1 then 1 else 0 end as bit) as disabled from sys_biz_perm_policy p inner join sys_biz_perm_scope s on s.policy_id = p.id and s.scope_type = 'DEPT' left join sys_dept d on cast(d.dept_id as nvarchar(64)) = s.scope_value
and (d.dept_name like '%' + #{keyword} + '%' or s.scope_value like '%' + #{keyword} + '%')
group by p.subject_type, p.subject_value, p.policy_code, s.scope_value order by p.subject_type, p.subject_value, p.policy_code, s.scope_value

select 'SCOPE:' + cast(min(s.policy_id) as nvarchar(20)) + ':' + s.scope_type + ':' + s.scope_value as node_key, 'SCOPE' as node_type, 'SCENE:' + p.subject_type + ':' + p.subject_value + ':' + p.policy_code as parent_key, case s.scope_type when 'USER' then coalesce(max(u.nick_name), max(nullif(s.scope_name, '')), s.scope_value) else coalesce(max(po.post_name), max(nullif(s.scope_name, '')), s.scope_value) end + '（' + s.scope_value + '）' as label, s.scope_value as code, cast(1 as bit) as has_children, cast(0 as bit) as leaf, cast(case when max(case when p.status = '0' then 0 else 1 end) = 1 then 1 else 0 end as bit) as disabled from sys_biz_perm_policy p inner join sys_biz_perm_scope s on s.policy_id = p.id and s.scope_type in ('USER', 'POST') left join sys_user u on s.scope_type = 'USER' and u.user_name = s.scope_value and u.del_flag = '0' left join sys_post po on s.scope_type = 'POST' and cast(po.post_id as nvarchar(64)) = s.scope_value
and (s.scope_value like '%' + #{keyword} + '%' or u.nick_name like '%' + #{keyword} + '%' or po.post_name like '%' + #{keyword} + '%')
group by p.subject_type, p.subject_value, p.policy_code, s.scope_type, s.scope_value order by p.subject_type, p.subject_value, p.policy_code, s.scope_type, s.scope_value

select p.subject_type as subject_type, p.subject_value as subject_value, p.policy_code as policy_code, count(distinct u.user_name) as user_count from sys_biz_perm_policy p inner join sys_biz_perm_scope s on s.policy_id = p.id inner join sys_user u on u.status = '0' and u.del_flag = '0' inner join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = u.dept_id where 1 = 1
and (p.policy_code like '%' + #{keyword} + '%' or p.policy_name like '%' + #{keyword} + '%')
and ( (s.scope_type = 'USER' and s.scope_value = u.user_name) or (s.scope_type = 'POST' and exists ( select 1 from sys_user_post up2 inner join sys_post po2 on po2.post_id = up2.post_id and po2.status = '0' where up2.user_id = u.user_id and up2.post_id = try_cast(s.scope_value as bigint) )) or (s.scope_type = 'DEPT' and ( u.dept_id = try_cast(s.scope_value as bigint) or (ltrim(rtrim(s.include_child)) = '1' and charindex(',' + s.scope_value + ',', ',' + d.ancestors + ',') > 0) )) ) group by p.subject_type, p.subject_value, p.policy_code

select top 200 'SCENE:' + p.subject_type + ':' + p.subject_value + ':' + p.policy_code as node_key, 'SCENE' as node_type, 'OWNER:' + p.subject_type + ':' + p.subject_value as parent_key, max(p.policy_name) + '（' + p.policy_code + '）' as label, p.policy_code as code, cast(1 as bit) as has_children, cast(0 as bit) as leaf, cast(case when max(case when p.status = '0' then 0 else 1 end) = 1 then 1 else 0 end as bit) as disabled from sys_biz_perm_policy p where p.subject_type = #{subjectType} and p.subject_value = #{subjectValue} group by p.subject_type, p.subject_value, p.policy_code order by p.policy_code

select top 200 'DEPT:' + cast(min(s.policy_id) as nvarchar(20)) + ':' + s.scope_value as node_key, 'DEPT' as node_type, 'SCENE:' + p.subject_type + ':' + p.subject_value + ':' + p.policy_code as parent_key, coalesce(max(d.dept_name), max(nullif(s.scope_name, '')), s.scope_value) + case when ltrim(rtrim(max(s.include_child))) = '1' then '（含下级）' else '' end as label, s.scope_value as code, cast(1 as bit) as has_children, cast(0 as bit) as leaf, cast(case when max(case when p.status = '0' then 0 else 1 end) = 1 then 1 else 0 end as bit) as disabled from sys_biz_perm_policy p inner join sys_biz_perm_scope s on s.policy_id = p.id and s.scope_type = 'DEPT' left join sys_dept d on cast(d.dept_id as nvarchar(64)) = s.scope_value where p.subject_type = #{subjectType} and p.subject_value = #{subjectValue} and p.policy_code = #{policyCode} group by p.subject_type, p.subject_value, p.policy_code, s.scope_value order by s.scope_value

select top 200 'SCOPE:' + cast(min(s.policy_id) as nvarchar(20)) + ':' + s.scope_type + ':' + s.scope_value as node_key, 'SCOPE' as node_type, 'SCENE:' + p.subject_type + ':' + p.subject_value + ':' + p.policy_code as parent_key, case s.scope_type when 'USER' then coalesce(max(u.nick_name), max(nullif(s.scope_name, '')), s.scope_value) else coalesce(max(po.post_name), max(nullif(s.scope_name, '')), s.scope_value) end + '（' + s.scope_value + '）' as label, s.scope_value as code, cast(1 as bit) as has_children, cast(0 as bit) as leaf, cast(case when max(case when p.status = '0' then 0 else 1 end) = 1 then 1 else 0 end as bit) as disabled from sys_biz_perm_policy p inner join sys_biz_perm_scope s on s.policy_id = p.id and s.scope_type in ('USER', 'POST') left join sys_user u on s.scope_type = 'USER' and u.user_name = s.scope_value and u.del_flag = '0' left join sys_post po on s.scope_type = 'POST' and cast(po.post_id as nvarchar(64)) = s.scope_value where p.subject_type = #{subjectType} and p.subject_value = #{subjectValue} and p.policy_code = #{policyCode} group by p.subject_type, p.subject_value, p.policy_code, s.scope_type, s.scope_value order by s.scope_type, s.scope_value

select distinct u.user_name as user_code, u.nick_name as nick_name, u.dept_id as dept_id, d.dept_name as dept_name from sys_user u inner join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = u.dept_id where u.status = '0' and u.del_flag = '0'
and exists ( select 1 from sys_biz_perm_scope s where s.policy_id = #{policyId} and s.scope_type = 'DEPT' and s.scope_value = #{scopeValue} and (u.dept_id = try_cast(s.scope_value as bigint) or (ltrim(rtrim(s.include_child)) = '1' and charindex(',' + s.scope_value + ',', ',' + d.ancestors + ',') > 0)) )
and exists ( select 1 from sys_user_post up where up.user_id = u.user_id and up.post_id = try_cast(#{scopeValue} as bigint) )
and u.user_name = #{scopeValue}
and (u.user_name like '%' + #{keyword} + '%' or u.nick_name like '%' + #{keyword} + '%')
order by u.user_name
select count(1) from sys_user where user_name = #{userCode} and status = '0' and del_flag = '0'
select count(1) from sys_dict_data where dict_type = 'biz_perm_policy' and dict_value = #{policyCode} and status = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into sys_biz_perm_policy (policy_code, policy_name, subject_type, subject_value, subject_name, include_child, status, remark, create_by, create_time) values (#{policyCode}, #{policyName}, #{subjectType}, #{subjectValue}, #{subjectName}, #{includeChild}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, getdate())

insert into sys_biz_perm_scope (policy_id, scope_type, scope_value, scope_name, include_child, order_num, create_by, create_time) values
(#{scope.policyId}, #{scope.scopeType}, #{scope.scopeValue}, #{scope.scopeName}, #{scope.includeChild}, #{scope.orderNum}, #{scope.createBy}, getdate())
